stem: In OpenStax Introductory Statistics, confounding means which problem for inference?

options.label: A
options.text: Only case-fatality calculation without multi-factor confusion
options.misconception: Wrong concept for this stem; does not match the cited passage.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: B
options.text: Only perfect randomization that removes every exposure difference
options.misconception: Wrong concept for this stem; does not match the cited passage.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: C
options.text: Only laboratory assay error without any factor overlap
options.misconception: Wrong concept for this stem; does not match the cited passage.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: D
options.text: Only vaccine cold-chain failure without analytic factor mixing
options.misconception: Wrong concept for this stem; does not match the cited passage.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: E
options.text: Effects of multiple factors on a response cannot be separated
options.misconception: None — this option matches the cited source passage for the stem.
options.explanation: This correct choice is supported by the cited FOSS passage.

context: Learning objective: recall confounding definition from the cited FOSS source.
